title: Battery draining
body: The app is very useful but it drains the battery. If you have a whole day routine, like me, it consumes a lot of battery as it is working all the time in the background. I hope you find a way to minimize the battery consumption. I find it very useful but I'm going to uninstall it because of the battery issue.
author: franciscobonessi
